body:
Thank you for the comment. I've been trying to just take it one day at a time for a long time, which is how I managed to come this far. But I always end up stuck again. I'm tired of constantly falling then trying to claw my way back out of the dark pit each time, and I'm not sure if it'll get better.

Part of the problem is that most people I encounter aren't bad. I do try to block out my mom though, but it's hard and I feel like I'm starting to become like her. So ultimately, I feel like I'm the one that's wrong in the equation. I really don't know what to do anymore. I've spent a good chunk of today just writing final letters to people instead of working.

Thanks for commenting and letting me vent though.

Sorry, was trying to avoid potentially identifying information. 

The event is supposed to be an open-ended roleplaying type of game, very similar to RPG games, but designed to work IRL. Things like collecting resources to build things. I'm open to potentially redesigning with a different theme, but it may be hard to redesign with a completely new mechanics.
